item.title: Charli xcx Releases ‘I Keep On Thinking Bout You Every Single Day and Night’ as ‘Rock Music’ Vinyl B-Side
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard. Today, we're talking about Charli XCX's latest release. The singer has just dropped a new B-side track, "I Keep On Thinking Bout You Every Single Day and Night", which is part of her new single "Rock Music" on vinyl.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: In this song, Charli explores themes of infatuation and even ponders her own sexuality, singing "maybe I could be gay". The track features minimalist production and a short runtime of just 1:32 minutes. The accompanying black-and-white video was shot in Kyoto, Japan, and features Charli in a sensual and intimate setting.
[Music transitions to a snippet of the song]
Host: The lyrics are open to interpretation, but one thing is clear - Charli is obsessed with the subject of her song. She repeats the chorus, "I keep thinkin' 'bout you, every single day / I keep thinkin' 'bout you, every single night". The song's inspiration is also rooted in French New Wave cinema, with references to Jacques Rivette.
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: Charli announced the track on her side Instagram account, @b.sides, where she shares behind-the-scenes content. Unfortunately, the song is not available on music streaming services, but you can watch the video on her Instagram page. The "Rock Music" 7" vinyl, which features this B-side track, is already sold out on her official webstore. But you can still find it at limited record stores in the US, UK, and France.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's it for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next one.
